summary: Completed frontend testing of DiaGyn Tutorial (Frosted Reveal style) feature. All 12 test cases PASSED: 1) 'How to Book' banner (data-testid='how-to-book-banner') visible on /diagyn page header. 2) Clicking 'How to Book' opens DiaGynTutorial modal (data-testid='diagyn-tutorial'). 3) Slide 1 shows 'Choose Doctor' with subtitle 'Browse profiles, ratings & specialties'. 4) Auto-play advances to Slide 2 'Pick Date & Time' after 2.8s. 5) Auto-play advances to Slide 3 'Find Clinic'. 6) Auto-play advances to Slide 4 'Confirmed!'. 7) Replay button (data-testid='diagyn-tutorial-replay') appears on last slide when not playing. 8) Dot navigation (data-testid='diagyn-tutorial-dot-0' to 'diagyn-tutorial-dot-3') works correctly. 9) Close button (data-testid='diagyn-tutorial-close') closes the modal. 10) REGRESSION: MangoTutorial still works on /labs page. 11) REGRESSION: OrangeTutorial still works on /pharmacy page. 12) REGRESSION: OrangeTutorial still works on /orange page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 279 verified: DiaGynTutorial with Frosted Reveal effect (glass blur that fades over 600ms) working correctly on /diagyn page. 'How to Book' banner opens the new 4-slide tutorial with images (Choose Doctor, Pick Date & Time, Find Clinic, Confirmed!). Auto-play is 2.8s per slide. Dot navigation, close button, and replay button all functional. Regression tests confirmed MangoTutorial (NeonLine style) on /labs and OrangeTutorial (Pictorial style) on /pharmacy and /orange still work correctly.
